zh: 环上相邻两数相差不超过 1，所以选中的不同取值必须是一段连续整数，中间不能有缺口。
沿着环从最小值走到最大值再走回来，每个内部取值都要被经过两次，所以内部取值至少要出现 2 次；两个端点取值各出现 1 次就够，多余的同值服务器可以挨着放。满足这个条件时，按值先递增再递减就能排成环。
统计每个值的频次，按值从小到大扫描，维护以当前值为右端点的最大合法总数 current：值不连续时重置为当前频次；与前一个值连续但前一个值只出现 1 次时，前一个值只能做左端点，current = 前一频次 + 当前频次；否则 current 加上当前频次。取所有 current 的最大值。
en: Adjacent values on the ring differ by at most 1, so the distinct values chosen must form a range of consecutive integers with no gaps.

Going around the ring from the smallest value up to the largest and back passes every interior value twice, so each interior value needs at least 2 copies; each of the two end values needs only 1, and extra copies of a value can sit next to each other. When this holds, arranging values increasing then decreasing forms a valid ring.

Count each value's frequency and scan the values in ascending order, keeping current, the best total for a valid range ending at the current value: reset it to the current frequency when the value is not consecutive; if it is consecutive but the previous value appears only once, the previous value can only be the left end, so current = previous count + current count; otherwise add the current frequency. Take the maximum of current.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The distinct values chosen must be consecutive, and every value except the two end values must appear at least twice. Count frequencies and scan consecutive keys: if the previous key has only 1 item, extending to a new key can only restart from that previous key; otherwise keep accumulating.

## Proof of correctness

There can be no gap between consecutive values. An interior value separates the two sides, and a round trip around the ring passes at least two servers with that value, so it needs 2 copies; each end needs only 1, and the remaining duplicate values can be placed next to an equal value. When these conditions hold, a ring can be built by going up through the values and then back down, so the condition is necessary and sufficient. The scan maintains the largest total frequency of a valid range whose right end is the current value.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
